sources.body: GAME_DESIGN §22 'disputa de corpo' and TECHNICAL_SPEC §7 BodyDuelWin (Força): a much stronger player wins most loose balls at equal distance; DESIGN ESTIMATE for 'most'
sources.rush: GAME_DESIGN §23: 'sai no 1×1 com bola exposta; sai na enfiada só se chega antes'; GkRushDecisionQuality (Posicionamento GK)
sources.headless: DESIGN ESTIMATE (A9b, X-75), 4-min matches strong × weak: the AI slides a few times per match and fouls with a minority of them; runs in behind and through balls every match; the keeper rushes now and then
